# Perry

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XIX. POOR ADAM! P15](../source/v05-c19.md#nw-v05-c19-p0015), [v5 CHAPTER XIX. POOR ADAM! P16](../source/v05-c19.md#nw-v05-c19-p0016)</sub>

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** Rev.  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XIX. POOR ADAM! P7](../source/v05-c19.md#nw-v05-c19-p0007)</sub>

## Appearance

Perry is a smooth, ruddy-faced man featuring a gleaming bald pate, thick white eyebrows, and a stubbly white moustache. He also has fleshy white hands, upon which he wears a well-formed diamond ring.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XIX. POOR ADAM! P7](../source/v05-c19.md#nw-v05-c19-p0007)_

## Personality

Perry is an unattractive clergyman known for his tedious and self-important demeanor. He has also been described as being overly smooth.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XIX. POOR ADAM! P7](../source/v05-c19.md#nw-v05-c19-p0007), [v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P2](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0002)_

## History

Perry was known to have hailed from [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) and spent his school days alongside an acquaintance, during which time he was considered an utterly insufferable young prig.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XX. GRACE MAKES A FRIEND P20](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0020)_

## Relationships

### [Grace](../character/grace.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/grace--perry.md)

[Grace](../character/grace.md) harbors hostility toward Perry after he ate her pet rooster, [Adam](../character/adam.md), and lectured her about it. Her anger over the loss of her pet was exacerbated by teasing at school, though she later found comfort in the sympathy of [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVIII. MARY BRINGS EVIL TIDINGS P0](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XVIII. MARY BRINGS EVIL TIDINGS P5](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER XVIII. MARY BRINGS EVIL TIDINGS P24](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0024), +6 more_
